en: Vintage sepia-toned postcard with two vignette photographs. The left vignette shows a rural inn or farmhouse with wooden buildings, a fenced yard and a horse‑drawn carriage; it is labeled "Gasthof von Fr. Erdnüss." The right vignette presents a general view of a small village in hilly countryside with scattered houses and a church with a tower; it is labeled "Gruss aus Birnbach." Handwritten German script text surrounds the images on the top and bottom margins.
